notes: All counts copied from berkshirehathaway.com news releases (or, for 2006, the June 26, 2006 pledge letters hosted at berkshirehathaway.com/donate/). No news articles or Wikipedia used.

Foundation fields: gates = Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (Trust); stbf = Susan Thompson Buffett Foundation; sherwood = Sherwood Foundation (formerly Susan A. Buffett Foundation); hgb = Howard G. Buffett Foundation; novo = NoVo Foundation. 0 = release says the foundation got nothing; null = release names the foundation (or is silent) but gives no per-foundation count.
totalB = total B shares donated per the release; aConverted / bFromConversion = A shares converted and resulting B shares, when stated.
type: 'annual' (five-foundation pledge gift), 'extra' (four family foundations only), 'pledge-schedule' (pledge letter, not a gift release).
Pre-2010 B counts are pre-split: multiply by 50 to compare with post-2010-split counts.

Year indexes at berkshirehathaway.com/news/YYYYnews.html were fetched for 2006-2026 (some needed a '?v=1' query string to get past a gzip/JS-redirect glitch). Where no gift release was listed, the year appears with found:false.
